title: Persistence shutdown can panic on a poisoned state mutex during fixture unwinding and abort the test binary
outcome: A failed test or prior state-lock panic does not cause a second panic from shutdown_persist_blocking; persistence failure is reported conservatively without claiming a successful flush.
acceptance: A deterministic subprocess regression demonstrates that shutdown after state mutex poisoning reports failure without aborting during an existing panic, preserving the first failure diagnostic.
Shutdown still joins its writer and preserves its durability semantics on the normal path; poison recovery does not manufacture a successful final flush.
Focused tests and the final landing gate pass with the required independent review pair.
